item.text: {"search_note":"Assessment of the gap: I did not find reliable 2024 primary-source evidence that Khamenei personally took concrete steps to reduce nuclear or broader existential risk, such as endorsing verifiable limits, negotiations, or reciprocal de-escalation measures. The evidence that does exist is mostly one of two kinds: restrained rhetoric after the April 19 Isfahan incident, and stronger, more explicit triumphal or deterrent rhetoric after the April 13 attack on Israel.
